title: What are this run’s GPUs doing? (run-wide)

panels.title: SM and tensor-pipe activity on this run's nodes
panels.description: SM-active and tensor-active fractions on this run’s attributed nodes. High SM activity with low tensor activity suggests kernels doing little matrix work. Node-level values include other workloads and ranks; requires node-agent DCGM reporting. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers. GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No GPU data. Over 7h: zoom to 7h or less. Otherwise no node join: trainer rows carry no node_name, or the node agent is not reporting this cluster.

panels.title: GPU memory in use on this run's nodes
panels.description: Mean and peak framebuffer bytes across attributed GPUs. Peaks near capacity mean little device-memory headroom. The node-level values include every process on each card; requires node-agent DCGM reporting. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers. GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No GPU data. Over 7h: zoom to 7h or less. Otherwise no node join: trainer rows carry no node_name, or the node agent is not reporting this cluster.

panels.title: NVLink against PCIe receive traffic
panels.description: NVLink and PCIe receive throughput summed across attributed GPUs. Compare changes with synchronization and step wall to identify transfer pressure. Counters cover links within the host; missing counters remain absent. Requires node-agent DCGM reporting. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers. GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No GPU data. Over 7h: zoom to 7h or less. Otherwise no node join: trainer rows carry no node_name, or the node agent is not reporting this cluster. Or no NVLink or PCIe counters from this cluster's node agent.

panels.title: PCIe replay errors and power on this run's GPUs
panels.description: GPUs with a positive PCIe replay-counter increase, alongside peak board power. Replays can identify link faults worth checking against host diagnostics. A counter reset contributes its new value; use the utilization panel to check GPU activity. Requires node-agent DCGM reporting. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers. GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No positive PCIe replay increase on this run's attributed GPUs in this window.
